mapper.select: SELECT id, title, status, result_visibility, deadline, created_at, updated_at FROM surveys ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, status, result_visibility, deadline, created_at, updated_at FROM surveys WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.title, s.status, s.result_visibility, s.deadline, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM surveys s INNER JOIN survey_target_groups stg ON s.id = stg.survey_id INNER JOIN user_group_mappings ugm ON stg.group_id = ugm.group_id WHERE ugm.username = #{username} ORDER BY s.deadline DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO surveys ( title, status, result_visibility, deadline, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{status}::survey_status, #{resultVisibility}::result_visibility, #{deadline}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE surveys SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}::survey_status, result_visibility = #{resultVisibility}::result_visibility, deadline = #{deadline}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
